title: Fix both kcov defects: correct denominator, and replace its numerator with a PS4 trace
objective: Make the shell-coverage instrument report the truth, so the allowlist campaign measures tests rather than tooling. kcov counted continuation lines of multi-line quoted arguments as statements (wrong denominator) and failed to record ordinary statements that provably execute (wrong numerator); the two together held dwm_config.sh at 47.95% and rpi_nc_install.sh at 11.36% regardless of how many tests were written.
acceptance_criteria: dot_resolver_install.sh still measures 39/39 = 100.00% through run_all.sh, gating at --min 100.
rpi_nc_ca.sh measures 73/73 = 100.00% -- it was 72/73 = 98.63% only because of cross-process contagion from test_dwm_config.sh, which a kcov-free trace pass cannot suffer.
No lib's percentage goes DOWN. A drop means a lost trace, not a stricter instrument.

The denominator is never derived from the trace. A PS4 trace reports only lines that ran, so trace-as-denominator would make every subject 100% and gate on nothing; kcov's line set is what keeps the gate meaningful.
meta/scripts/lib/shell_coverage_lines.py and meta/scripts/shell_coverage_report.py both hold 100% branch coverage.
pre-commit passes on every touched file with no suppression added.
out_of_scope: Adding a second denominator-exclusion rule for `done < <(...)` process substitution. Every line removed from a denominator inflates coverage -- the fail-open direction -- so it must be justified per line, not generalised from one lib.
Wiring check_shell_coverage.sh into pre-commit/pre-push/CI, which waits for the allowlist to reach zero.
The unrelated red `Python tests` CI job (pip resolution-too-deep since 2026-08-17).
verifier: bash meta/scripts/shell_coverage_jail.sh --subject linux_configuration/scripts/single_use/features/lib/tests/run_all.sh $(jail_args) --measure dot_resolver_install.sh --min 100 --fail-on-case-error -- "" and the same for rpi_nc_ca.sh (both must exit 0), plus python3 -m pytest python_pkg/tests/test_shell_coverage_lines.py python_pkg/tests/test_shell_coverage_report.py (expects 29 passed), plus pre-commit run --files on the touched files.
